violations.text:
No paper towels or mechanical hand drying device provided at handwash sink.
At bar
Spray bottle containing toxic substance not labeled.

Duct tape used to repair nonfood-contact surface.
Used on 2 door glass cooler to hold handle in place.
Ice buckets upstairs not stored inverted or in a protected manner.

Pesticide-emitting strip present in upstairs bar.
Manager threw away

Raw animal food stored over/not properly separated from ready-to-eat food.
Raw beef over shredded cheese in reach in cooler. Chef discarded cheese

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
Raw shrimp 43-47f. Chef added ice. Retemped at 40f

Employee personal items stored in or above a food preparation area, food, clean equipment and utensils, or single-service items.
Backpack on mixer attachment
Ice bucket stored on floor between uses.

Nonfood-contact surface soiled with grease, food debris, dirt, slime or dust.
Hood filters

Waste line missing at soda gun holster.
At pool bar

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
Queso cheese found at 54f in expo cooler. In service for 3 hours. Advised to rapid chill
Carbon dioxide/helium tanks not adequately secured.

Food stored on floor.
Bag of onions in walk in cooler. Chef moved
Inaccurate/damaged temperature and/or pressure gauge(s) on dishmachine.

Nonfood-contact surface soiled with grease, food debris, dirt, slime or dust.
Above grill. Chef took down to clean

Shell eggs in use or stored with cracks or broken shells. See stop sale.
Flat in walk in cooler with one broken shell. Chef discarded

Required employee training expired for some employees. To order approved program food safety material, call DBPR contracted provider: Florida Restaurant and Lodging Association (SafeStaff) 866-372-7233.
